reason: Provides web search and URL fetching through multiple external providers, with normalized results, round-robin selection, and automatic failover.

summaries.zh: 通过 Keenable、Exa 和 Tavily 提供统一的网页搜索与指定网址内容抓取工具，并支持轮询和故障切换。
summaries.en: Provides unified web search and specified-URL content fetching through Keenable, Exa, and Tavily with round-robin routing and failover.

capabilities: Searches the web through Keenable, Exa, and Tavily APIs
Fetches and returns content from specified URLs
Reads provider API keys from environment variables or a local .env file
Exposes search and fetch tools through a native plugin or stdio MCP server
